game.title: Far Cry 5
game.blurb: Open-world first-person shooter set in Hope County, Montana, where a doomsday cult has taken over, from Ubisoft Montreal (with other Ubisoft studios), released 2018-03-27. RAWG average playtime: 19 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: A junior deputy trapped in Hope County takes on the Project at Eden's Gate, region by region. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Exploring Hope County
chapters.summary: Liberating locations, side missions, treasure hunts, Clutch Nixon stunts, collectibles, fishing and hunting, and the locals.

chapters.title: Combat, Vehicles and Gear
chapters.summary: Takedowns, long shots, vehicles and planes, crafting, perks, weapons, clothes and the garage.

chapters.title: Far Cry Arcade
chapters.summary: Arcade levels, featured maps, Arcade Hero and Arcade multiplayer.

chapters.title: The Vietnam DLC (likely Hours of Darkness)
chapters.summary: A separate campaign with its own story, Action Movie and Survivor modes, prisoners of war and airstrikes.

chapters.title: Lost on Mars (DLC)
chapters.summary: Arachnids, the Power Glove, Larry's notes and the Queens.

chapters.title: Dead Living Zombies (DLC)
chapters.summary: Seven zombie movie pitches, their score attack medals and the Blood Dragon.

chapters.title: New Game+ on Infamous
chapters.summary: Finishing New Game+ on the Infamous difficulty.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). No StrategyWiki page under "Far Cry 5" (no alternative title tried; "Far Cry V" is also missing). farcry.fandom.com answers the API, with about 231 linked pages, including "Hours of Darkness", "Lost On Mars" and "Dead Living Zombies"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 72 Steam achievements is hidden. The Mars and Zombies DLC achievements carry "DLC: Mars" and "DLC Zombies" prefixes in their names and were placed by those prefixes. The seven untagged achievements listed between the base game and the Mars block ("Silent Death" to "Welcome to Nam", with Action Movie and Survivor modes, US prisoners of war and "Welcome to Nam") were grouped as one DLC campaign by schema position; naming it Hours of Darkness is an inference from RAWG and Fandom listing that DLC, not stated in the achievement data. "Silent Death" carries no "Campaign only" tag and was put in that block by position, which needs checking. The base story achievements say "Solo Campaign only".
